subject.title: docs: The main session concept page and shipped-sidebar updates

question: Does a docs owner confirm that the final main-session page accurately describes the current default DM scope, conditional cross-conversation recall, and Home/sidebar terminology after rebasing onto current main?
rationale: The PR is documentation-only but consolidates several same-day behavior and UI changes, and its protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Confirm and merge after refresh
options.body: Rebase onto current main, verify the behavior claims against the merged feature contracts, and merge if the wording remains accurate.

options.title: Narrow the claims
options.body: Keep the new concept page but remove or soften any assertion that cannot be confirmed as a stable current contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm and merge after refresh
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, verify the behavior claims against the merged feature contracts, and merge if the wording remains accurate.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored most of the merged behavior and UI changes whose terminology this PR documents.
